meaning:
ἔν-ειμι
1. to be in, within (Job.27:3, al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, Luk.11:41 (R, txt., cf. MM, Exp., xii).
2. to be possible: Luk.11:41 (R, mg.).†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: of such things as ye have

elsewhere.note: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
